name: the curtained booths in a hidden Greater Plum Harbor courtyard
about: The cloth-curtained tea-shop booth deep in the enclave where Gladias meets Delwart in chapters 3 and 13. The book gives only the details listed below; the rest of the design is invented, and contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.quote: in the middle of a hidden courtyard. There were several tables and chairs, with people eating and drinking water.
facts.fact: The booths open off a hidden courtyard with tables.

facts.quote: a booth that had a cloth curtain protecting it
facts.fact: The booth is closed by a cloth curtain.

facts.quote: There was a decorated lamp in the middle of the far end of the table, with one large flower on each side.
facts.fact: A decorated lamp flanked by two flowers at the end of the table.

facts.quote: pressed against the corner of the booth, Gladias noticed a white box
facts.fact: A white air filter box in a floor corner.

facts.quote: a green circle in the middle of a table
facts.fact: A green circle in the tabletop for ordering and paying.

facts.quote: a robot with a smiley face slid up to the table
facts.fact: A serving robot with a smiley face.

facts.quote: some totally different tea shop in GPH
facts.fact: The booths belong to tea shops in the enclave.

facts.quote: a table, a decorated lamp and two flowers at the end, and an air filter pressed against a corner on the floor
facts.fact: Every booth has the same layout.

facts.quote: I could listen through the vibrations on the wall
facts.fact: The walls are thin enough to eavesdrop through.

descriptor: a small private booth in a hidden courtyard tea shop, closed by a heavy cloth curtain, with a narrow table between cushioned benches, a decorated lamp flanked by two large flowers at the far end, a white boxy air filter in a floor corner, a glowing green circle inset in the tabletop, thin smooth walls of white, grey and purple, and a small serving robot with a smiling screen face
